resolution.question: Will Harborview Credit Union provisionally credit Marisol's disputed 320-dollar card charge within the ten-business-day window she was quoted when she filed today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Harborview Credit Union provisionally credited $320 to Marisol's account on or before 2026-10-28T17:00:00-08:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
